archetypes.name: Crowd Control
archetypes.description: Freeze, burn, or slow swarms while your team cleans up.

archetypes.name: Single-Target DPS
archetypes.description: Focus down high-value targets and delete Dreadnoughts.

archetypes.name: Area Denial
archetypes.description: Control zones and punish bugs for stepping into your territory.

archetypes.name: Mobility
archetypes.description: Speed demon. Get in, get out, leave chaos behind.

archetypes.name: Support
archetypes.description: Keep the team alive and make everyone else better.

scout.crowd-control: Light 'em up and slow 'em down. Your team will thank you.
scout.single-target: One shot, one kill. High-value targets don't stand a chance.
scout.area-denial: Plasma and fire everywhere. Bugs hate this one simple trick.
scout.mobility: Fastest dwarf in the caves. Hit and run specialist.
scout.support: Keep eyes on threats and mark targets for the team.

gunner.crowd-control: Wall of lead. Nothing gets through.
gunner.single-target: Big guns for big bugs. Dreadnought deleter.
gunner.mobility: Heavy firepower, surprisingly mobile. Zipline to victory.
gunner.support: Shield up, guns blazing. The team's anchor.

engineer.crowd-control: Turrets and tech keep the swarm at bay.
engineer.area-denial: Platform fortress builder. This is MY cave now.
engineer.support: Platforms, turrets, and team utility. The backbone.

driller.crowd-control: Freeze or burn, pick your poison. Swarms melt.
driller.area-denial: Toxic, burning, freezing zones. Enter at your own risk.
driller.mobility: Drill straight to the objective. No detours.
driller.support: Create paths and control the battlefield for your team.
